# Tidepool Landing Page Build Plan

**Global system**
- **Palette:** Deep tide teal `#0F3D3E` (text, dark sections), sea foam `#CFE8E1` (tinted backgrounds), sand `#F6F1E7` (page background), coral `#E8795B` (primary CTAs only).
- **Type:** Fraunces for headlines (soft serif, warm), Instrument Sans for body and UI labels. Headlines at 56px desktop, body at 18px.
- **Imagery:** Hand-drawn line illustrations of tidepools and shorelines, no stock photos. Real product screenshots appear in cards with rounded corners and soft shadows.

**1. Navigation**
Sticky, sand background. Logo left, three links (Product, Pricing, Teams), and a coral "Start free" button right. Collapses to a menu icon under 768px.

**2. Hero**
Two columns. Left: H1 "Your week, planned together." Subhead: "Tidepool gives small teams one shared view of who's doing what, when, without another standing meeting." Primary coral CTA "Start planning free" and a text link "See how it works." Right: a product screenshot of the weekly board, slightly tilted, with an illustrated tidepool beneath it. Background: sand with a faint wave pattern.

**3. Social proof strip**
Full-width foam band. Single line of logos or a count ("Used by 4,000+ teams of 2 to 12"). No carousel.

**4. Problem**
Centered, one paragraph in large serif. Copy names the pain directly: "Monday standups, Slack threads, and three tabs later, nobody knows what's actually happening this week." Background stays sand, with generous whitespace.

**5. How it works**
Three numbered columns on sand. Each has a small illustration and a verb-led title: "Share your week," "Drop in priorities," "Sync in five minutes." Body copy is two sentences each, plain and concrete.

**6. Feature spotlight**
Alternating layout. Large screenshot of the team view on the left, with three checkmarked bullets on the right. Bullets describe outcomes ("See conflicts before they happen"), not features.

**7. Use cases**
Dark teal background, sand text. Three tabs or cards: "Product teams," "Agencies," "Remote founders." Each shows a short quote-style scenario.

**8. Testimonials**
Two or three large quote cards on foam. Real names, roles, and team sizes. Avoid generic praise; quotes should mention a specific week that improved.

**9. Pricing**
Three tiers side by side on sand. Middle tier highlighted with a teal border. Free tier emphasized for teams under five. Toggle for monthly/annual. Each tier lists four benefits maximum.

**10. FAQ**
Single column accordion, six questions: pricing, data privacy, integrations, team size limits, cancellation, and "Do we need everyone to sign up?"

**11. Final CTA**
Full-bleed coral-tinted band with a tide illustration. H2 "Plan next week before Monday." One button, no secondary link.

**12. Footer**
Teal background, four link columns, small wordmark, and a line: "Made for teams who'd rather be doing the work."

# Tidepool Landing Page Build Plan (Revised)

**What changed:** The week timeline becomes a recurring structural device. The hand-drawn arrow carries the story from headline to product. One monospace pull quote gives the page a distinct voice. The headline stays short. We also cut unverified claims.

**Global system**
- **Palette:** Tide teal `#0F3D3E` (text, dark bands), sea foam `#CFE8E1` (tinted bands), sand `#F6F1E7` (page background), coral `#E8795B` (CTAs and "today" marker only). Coral never appears as decoration. Check all text pairs against WCAG AA.
- **Type:** Fraunces for headlines, Instrument Sans for body and UI, and JetBrains Mono for one pull quote and timestamps only. Headlines at 56px desktop, body at 18px.
- **Motif:** A vertical week timeline, Monday to Sunday, with a node per day. The coral node marks "today." It recurs in the hero, feature spotlight, and footer.
- **Imagery:** Hand-drawn line illustrations of tidepools and shorelines, plus hand-drawn arrows. No stock photos. Product screenshots sit in rounded cards with soft shadows.

**1. Navigation**
Sticky, sand background. Logo left, links (Product, Pricing, Teams), coral "Start free" button right. Under 768px, collapses to a menu icon.

**2. Hero**
Two columns with a week timeline running down the far-left edge. Nodes are filled up to the current day.
- **Left:** H1 "Your week, planned together." (Maximum eight words for any H1.) Subhead: "One shared view of who's doing what, when, without another standing meeting." Coral CTA "Start planning free" and text link "See how it works."
- **Right:** Weekly board screenshot, slightly tilted. A hand-drawn arrow runs from the H1 to the screenshot.
- **Background:** Sand with a faint wave line.

**3. Social proof strip**
Foam band with one line: a verified count, or a named customer list if no count is available. Do not publish a figure we cannot back. No carousel.

**4. Problem**
Centered, one large serif paragraph on sand. The timeline appears as a thin vertical rule with scattered, unfilled nodes, signaling a week with no shared view. Copy: "Standups, Slack threads, and three tabs later, nobody knows what this week actually holds."

**5. How it works**
Three columns on sand, each anchored to a timeline node: Monday, Wednesday, Friday. Verb-led titles: "Share your week," "Drop in priorities," "Sync in five minutes." Two plain sentences each.

**6. Feature spotlight**
Alternating layout. Left: team view screenshot with the timeline visible. Right: three outcome bullets ("See conflicts before they happen"). Each bullet links to a relevant node on the timeline.

**7. Use cases**
Dark teal band, sand text. Three cards: "Product teams," "Agencies," "Remote founders." Each card has a two-line scenario, written as a specific week.

**8. Testimonials**
Foam background. One large testimonial set in monospace, styled like a standup log with a timestamp and attribution. Two supporting quotes in serif cards. Each quote names a specific week that got better, with a real name, role, and team size.

**9. Pricing**
Three tiers on sand. Middle tier outlined in teal. Free tier targets teams under five. Monthly/annual toggle. Maximum four benefits per tier.

**10. FAQ**
Single-column accordion, seven questions: pricing, data privacy, integrations, team size limits, cancellation, "Do we need everyone to sign up?", and "How is this different from a shared calendar?"

**11. Final CTA**
Full-bleed coral-tinted band with a tide illustration. H2 "Plan next week before Monday." One button, no secondary link.

**12. Footer**
Teal background, four link columns, wordmark, and a mini timeline across the top. Line: "Made for teams who'd rather be doing the work."

**Responsive and accessibility notes**
- Under 768px, the hero timeline becomes a horizontal strip above the headline.
- Honor `prefers-reduced-motion` for the arrow draw-in and timeline fill.
- Every illustration needs alt text or is marked decorative.
